root_cause: The V2 worker now has a real scoring path and a frozen Batch1 cohort, but four execution-critical gaps remain. Its deadline is created only after imports and is checked only between forward batches, so model loading can exceed the 1800-second hard cap without active termination. Runtime model identity checks do not verify the actual full base shard/config/tokenizer set or adapter config bytes. The package retains an aggregate-DEV H3 decision rule that conflicts with the new family-aligned rule, and the worker records raw rows without invoking or emitting the numerical-stability classification. Finally, the claimed negative-test gate contains only two conclusion_stable unit tests and does not exercise authorization, identity, freshness, or cap failures.

required_changes: Replace the conflicting decision text with one authoritative frozen family-aligned rule. Before NLL execution, derive and freeze per-family DEV exact-match counts from the three already frozen result artifacts without opening new labels. Define fit-improved family, H1-supported, H3-supported and INCONCLUSIVE mutually exclusively; repeats are numerical stability checks, not independent statistical samples.

Add a deterministic CPU postprocessor or equivalent terminal analysis that aggregates the raw paired rows, applies the frozen family rule, calls the B1-versus-B32 conclusion-stability check, and emits NUMERICALLY_INCONCLUSIVE whenever any named family delta sign or final classification changes. Preserve raw rows regardless of outcome.

Enforce the 1800-second cap from before framework/model import through final receipt using an external active watchdog or parent launcher able to stop a hung load/forward process. On timeout, preserve a capped terminal receipt and mark all partial output INCOMPLETE_NOT_INTERPRETABLE.

Before model import, verify the actual runtime base-model identity against the trusted complete manifest, including every expected weight shard plus config/tokenizer files and forbidden extras where specified; verify both adapter weight and adapter config for all three checkpoints. Do not rely on a manifest-file hash while loading an unchecked directory.

Expand CPU negative tests to cover non-CONTINUE authorization, altered config/worker/source/cap binding, stale output, TRAIN/manifest/crosscheck mismatch, incomplete base or adapter identity, timeout classification, and synthetic B1/B32 sign or conclusion reversal. Run the tests and freeze their exact result.

Prepare exact source provenance and launch command for the repaired bytes. Do not push without the owner's separate Git push authorization; if push is the sole remaining blocker, report AUTH_REQUIRED_GIT_PUSH rather than weakening provenance.

frozen_conditions: The selected H1-versus-H3 question, three checkpoints, all-400 primary manifest, five weak families, 32-row validation-only Batch1 cohort, three repeats, BF16 forward, FP32 loss aggregation and 1800-second cap remain unchanged.
Batch32 remains primary; Batch1 is only a conclusion-stability crosscheck and must not become a new numerical-equivalence research program.
No prior checkpoint, evaluation result, closed diagnostic, controlled stop, threshold or terminal decision may be altered or reinterpreted.

Do not run the superseded timing pilot.
Do not train, optimize, backpropagate, generate, mutate checkpoints, use DEV or retention labels in NLL, or open FINAL_AUDIT.
